methodology.build: one warmup then 9 host-ingestion plus construction samples; indexed provider order rotated across samples
methodology.query: per-provider iteration calibration; provider order rotated per batch; complete oracle validation before and after timing
methodology.oracle: independent exhaustive scan and full nearest-distance sort
methodology.scope: 2D planar queries; public geographic coordinates are not geodesic distances
methodology.selection: all declared matrix cases, including no-hit and slower cases; errors and unsupported rows retained

provenance.name: OurAirports global airports
provenance.coordinates: WGS84 longitude/latitude treated as planar coordinates in degrees; not geodesic distance
provenance.selection: All rows with finite longitude/latitude inside their valid ranges; no airport-type or performance-based selection
provenance.format: little-endian Float64 [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] per record
